item.title: Royal Mail Warns of Delivery Delays in Harborough District
item.description: Royal Mail has warned of potential service delays in parts of the Harborough District due to staff sickness and poor weather. The delivery office in Lutterworth, which serves the LE17 and LE9 postcode areas, is one of 38 bases affected nationwide. item.title: Suicide Prevention Forum Planned in Market Harborough
item.description: A meeting will take place next month to strengthen suicide prevention efforts in the Market Harborough area. Harborough District Council has announced a roundtable event on March 11th, bringing together support groups and agencies to discuss closer working. item.title: Supply Teacher Banned After Being Found Under the Influence
item.description: A supply teacher who worked at Robert Smyth Academy in Market Harborough has been banned from the profession after being found under the influence of alcohol.
